title: FICO Cuts 15% of Staff to Integrate AI
summary:
The provider of credit analytics is embedding artificial intelligence into its product suite to accelerate development and operational efficiency. FICO will eliminate about 15% of its workforce to facilitate this transition and simplify its internal business processes, according to a shift toward deeper AI integration in product development.

Critics have attributed the job reductions to a loss of customers after the company reportedly increased prices 17 times over five years. FICO shares have declined 64% this year as mortgage giants Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac move to allow the use of competing scores from VantageScore.
